texts.emk_first_open: Buɗewa ta farko a wannan na'ura (ba a adana komai ba tukuna)
texts.ph_draft_kept: An ajiye daftarinka a wannan na'ura.
texts.ph_logo_checking: Tambarinka yana jiran a duba shi. Har zuwa lokacin, baƙaƙen sunanka za su bayyana.
texts.ph_plans_where: Mai shagon ne ke canza tsari a Saitunan kasuwanci, a sashen Tsarin biyan kuɗi.
texts.ph_slow: Wannan yana ɗaukar lokaci fiye da yadda aka saba.
